decisions.statement: The sales capture reaches this module as text rather than as a path.
A sale entry with a key the sale shape does not name refuses the import.
A sale entry with no sale id refuses the import.
A sale entry with an empty sale id refuses the import.
A sale entry omitting its item name, its price or its tax refuses the import.
A refusal names the key the sale it refused sat under.
The net payout is the price less the tax.
A sale's slug is the sale id in lower case.
Every run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 becomes one dash.
A dash at either end of a sale's slug is dropped.
A sale id reducing to nothing takes the bare sale slug.
A saved-variables file with no Default table refuses the import.
A saved-variables file with no account-wide table refuses the import.
An account-wide table whose sales are no table of sales refuses the import.
An account-wide table naming no sales at all plans no sale write.
An empty plan asks the session for nothing and writes nothing.
The account page is written before the first sale is written.
A sale with no sold-at time is written with no sold-at value.
A sold-at time counted in seconds is written as a UTC timestamp.
Nothing here reaches the clock.
A sale write refuses before reaching a file.

definition: a sales capture read into one plan of sale page writes under an account page
